summary: Implementation plan to transform desktop viewport layout into an auto-adapting, spacious, fluid widescreen interface across Chromium and modern desktop displays. Upgrades container widths from rigid 1280px (max-w-7xl) to responsive fluid max-w-[1600px] 2xl:max-w-[1720px], adds responsive 5-to-6 column grid scaling for high-resolution monitors, and balances header and hero banners to eliminate the narrow centered-column feel.
